item.text:
**Verdict**  
Mixed, leaning negative. The strongest positive evidence is technocratic staffing and some rule-based humanitarian delivery; the strongest negative evidence is a broad, politically salient cash-transfer program, pressure on an independent technocratic institution, and a patronage-linked cabinet appointment.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Thailand's Cabinet Reshuffle Welcomes Six New Ministers](https://thailand.prd.go.th/en/content/category/detail/id/52/iid/283531) | Public Relations Department | 2024-04-29 | URL: https://thailand.prd.go.th/en/content/category/detail/id/52/iid/283531 | Srettha put Pichai Chunhavajira, a former SET and Bank of Thailand board figure, in Finance. That is a real technocratic staffing signal for the funding side of service delivery. | IDs: `6B.5`; also `6B.4`

- [Special Envoy of ASEAN Chair on Myanmar welcomes successful pilot project of humanitarian initiative between Thailand and Myanmar](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm260324-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e) | Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand | 2024-03-26 | URL: https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm260324-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e | Thailand used Red Cross and AHA Centre channels for cross-border aid, which is evidence of monitored, transparent delivery rather than patronage or improvisation. | IDs: `6B.5`; also `6B.2`, `6B.3`

- [Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs and IO representatives discuss Thailand and Myanmar border situation and explore further possible humanitarian cooperation](https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm-chairs-hm-asst-mtg-260424-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e) | Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand | 2024-04-26 | URL: https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm-chairs-hm-asst-mtg-260424-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e | Thailand coordinated with UNHCR, UNICEF, WFP, UNDP, ICRC, and others to scale assistance to vulnerable people. That is strong evidence of professional humanitarian administration. | IDs: `6B.5`; also `6B.2`, `6B.3`

- [Thailand's $13 billion digital handout scheme to include cash payments, PM says](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-pm-says-part-of-13-billion-digital-wallet-stimulus-to-be-in-cash-3597164) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-03 | URL: https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-pm-says-part-of-13-billion-digital-wallet-stimulus-to-be-in-cash-3597164 | The government changed part of the flagship program into cash. That is some correction, but it reads more like tactical compromise than a transparent, evidence-led redesign. | IDs: `6B.5`; also `6B.2`, `6B.3`

- [Thailand approves 135 billion baht digital wallet handout](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/thailands-cabinet-approves-135-billion-digital-wallet-handout-3390007) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-04-23 | URL: https://www.investing.com/news/economy/thailands-cabinet-approves-135-billion-digital-wallet-handout-3390007 | Cabinet approved a universal 10,000-baht transfer to 50 million people. Reuters reported immediate debt and fiscal-risk criticism, so the policy was broad and popular but not obviously evidence-hardened or well-targeted. | IDs: `6B.5`; also `6B.2`, `6B.3`

- [Thailand's flagship 14 billion handout](https://www.yahoo.com/news/thailands-flagship-14-billion-handout-072635149.html) | Reuters via Yahoo News | 2024-08-01 | URL: https://www.yahoo.com/news/thailands-flagship-14-billion-handout-072635149.html | Reuters reported registration snags, delayed launch timing, and criticism from economists and former central bankers. That weakens the claim that Srettha used feedback loops to improve delivery. | IDs: `6B.5`; also `6B.2`, `6B.3`

- [Thai central bank holds key rate, defies government calls for cuts](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-central-bank-holds-key-rate-defies-government-calls-for-cuts-3372713) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-04-10 | URL: https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-central-bank-holds-key-rate-defies-government-calls-for-cuts-3372713 | The government repeatedly pressured the independent BOT to cut rates, which suggests short-term political pressure rather than disciplined, evidence-based stewardship. | IDs: `6B.5`; also `6B.4`

- [Forty Thai senators seek PM's dismissal over cabinet appointment](https://theprint.in/world/forty-thai-senators-seek-pms-dismissal-over-cabinet-appointment/2089532/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-05-17 | URL: https://theprint.in/world/forty-thai-senators-seek-pms-dismissal-over-cabinet-appointment/2089532/ | Senators challenged Srettha over appointing Pichit Chuenban, a politically connected former lawyer with a contempt/bribery history. That is strong patronage evidence and cuts against a technocratic correction model. | IDs: `6B.5`; also `6B.4`

- [Thailand Economic Monitor July 2024: Unlocking the Growth Potential of Secondary Cities](https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/thailand/publication/temjuly2024) | World Bank | 2024-07-03 | URL: https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/thailand/publication/temjuly2024 | The Bank warned debt and deficit would rise with stimulus and urged more targeted social assistance. That is indirect, but it points away from broad untargeted spending as the best evidence-based approach. | IDs: `6B.5`; also `6B.2`

**Search gap**
I did not find direct evidence of service-delivery dashboards, KPIs, randomized pilots, public scorecards, or post-launch performance reviews in health, education, water/sanitation, housing, or routine social services under Srettha. The evidence is mostly about cash transfers, humanitarian coordination, technocratic appointments, and resistance to technocratic independence, not about a sustained measurement-and-correction system for service delivery.
